Prove binary start and single-token simulation plus static admission equivalence; verify actual arbitrary refusal/exhaustion cases rather than a success-only specialization.
Prove arbitrary-entry continuation, prefix and admitted binary run correspondence; verify independent F03 expectations alongside direct binary comparison.
Prove continuation append and three-chunk equality on arbitrary machines; verify populated-entry F09 and order-sensitive withdrawal7/6 negative, with no participant-tree associativity claim.
Define local actual-success, cross-inclusion and stability obligations; prove simultaneous initialized prefix induction and verify arbitrary finite roster binders and refusal/skip identity cases.
Instantiate actual accepted M2 total/global-binding hypotheses for three streams; verify F18 retains all global edges and full initialized values at every prefix.

Prove and execute material counterexamples F11/F13/F14/F15/F19 for authorization-only, unstable peers, missing initialization, circular promises and omitted global edges; verify each classification and remaining premises explicitly.
Implement separate actual-input monitor step and continuation, with no financial control path; verify actual success/error/none inputs and unchanged base erasure in F07–F10.

Prove arbitrary-entry erasure, actual replay trace correspondence, monitor append and fixed-parameter common-prefix equality; verify actual appended-attempt provenance and state explicitly that captured callback constants or externally supplied initial monitor facts are not ruled out by the argument shape.

Define separate causal initialization, present assumption derivation, local guarantee, peer stability and monitor-update obligations; prove the generic rule and inspect that no whole-run conclusion or future success is assumed.

Construct the literal funded p0 producer/consumer plus two deposit streams and monitor; prove budget initialization, own-output provenance and deposit stability separately, checking F10 independently expected receipts and full stores.

Prove reserve at every actual prefix and actual success/final balances for arbitrary complete witness schedules; verify the separate guard/enabledness argument and all twelve complete schedule checks F10.

Construct and prove actual stale-budget, refused-producer and wrong-stream companions F12/F16/F17; verify remaining validity/authority premises and exact successful or refused outcomes without artificial rejection guards.

Complete all nineteen fixture IDs and their explicitly classified variants, exact expected observations and unique nonempty runtime check IDs; obtain nonauthor fixture source review and map every scenario to its actual proof/check evidence.

Implement Nary Audit and defensive CLI adaptation with runtime-only imports and precise proof-tail stripping; verify all final inherited controls plus any separately justified additions, including actual production-form evaluation/error controls.

Freeze sixteen concrete source mutation sites and run each compiled production mutation; verify its intended false semantic check, protected positives, source isolation and actual per-command timeout/duration.

Preserve every compiler failure, timeout, cancellation, malformed/empty output and retry; verify none receives semantic detection credit and every accepted mutant has full stdout/stderr/source/artifact hashes.

Add only required root/audit imports and run fresh integrated Lean/actual runtime checks at the final candidate; verify previous source semantics are unchanged and required existing regression dependencies are fresh or explicitly equivalent.

Generate actual imported full statements and axiom inventory, including private/generated/supplemental declarations and concrete versus generic claims; verify exact Lean/compiler/source hashes and zero sorry/custom axioms/native_decide.
Reconcile complete scenario/fixture/mutation/control evidence with normative requirements and actual commands; verify nonempty counts and distinguish bounded checks, formal proofs and assumptions.

Obtain independent native Grok/Fable5.1 medium implementation/evidence verdicts on the same frozen candidate, repair required findings and preserve prior reports; verify actual returned model and before/after input hashes.
Publish accepted source/evidence and archive only after final adjudication; verify remote bytes and mark M3 complete without closing M4 participant-tree/regrouping or deployed-system claims.
